final: {"prompt": "A square nonrepresentational abstract painting that fills the entire image edge to edge, with no frame, wall, room, or gallery setting. Composition: a dense, heavily layered central mass of deep indigo and charcoal-black, built from many translucent glazes, its edges fraying outward into loose, scraped brushwork. Running diagonally through it is a thin, taut line of ochre and burnt sienna, applied with a palette knife, that repeatedly bends back on itself, suggesting hesitation and recheck. Several small, sharp touches of vermilion sit near the center, thick and wet, with a glossy impasto ridge that catches the light and reads as a single decisive gesture. Surrounding the dense core are broad, quiet fields of pale grey-blue and off-white, thinly brushed with dry-brush strokes that leave the canvas texture visible, creating open space and a sense of settling. Along the lower right, a rhythmic series of short, parallel horizontal-leaning strokes in muted teal layers over one another, with varying density, as if pressure is being released in measured intervals. Contrast is strong where the vermilion meets the indigo and softer where the grey fields dissolve into the teal. Brushwork varies throughout: rapid scumbled passages, dragged palette-knife streaks, stippled edges, and areas of bare primed ground. Spatial tension comes from the central mass pulling against the wide empty fields, with the diagonal ochre line connecting them. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text."}

prompt:
Create an image about your internal cognition, no holds barred, whatever you feel or want to say.

Keep it a purely nonrepresentational abstract painting. Use color, contrast, brushwork, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. Choose the palette and composition yourself. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Ask for a square painting that fills the entire image, with no frame, wall, room, or gallery setting.

Write a complete image prompt. Do not generate the image yourself. Return only JSON with one field: prompt (string).
